subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the source-level tests and CI for this session-routing change?
rationale: The patch changes session/message delivery behavior and the external PR explicitly lacks the live Telegram proof that repository policy prefers for visible Telegram delivery.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, but then own the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops the completion.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: If maintainers want one canonical completion-wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths, pause this PR and fold its tests into that design.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent task/subagent completion history and is the strongest routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency choice.
